explanations: recordScan checks out a connection, and while it still holds it, calls refreshStatus, which asks the pool for a second one. Alone that works, but each scan briefly needs two connections. When as many scans run at once as the pool has connections (4 workers on a pool of 4), each holds one and waits for another that will never be released: a pool-exhaustion deadlock. The fix passes the connection it already holds to a shared updateStatus(conn, ...) helper, so a scan uses exactly one connection from start to finish. refreshStatus keeps its own checkout for callers that don't hold one.
